templates.name: Search cruises with filters
templates.description: Search cruises using the home search form with destination {sail_to}, departure port {sail_from}, dates {dates}, duration {duration}, and optional guests/ship.
steps: Open Sail To and choose the destination
Open Sail From and choose the departure port (if given)
Open Dates and choose the month (if given)
Open Duration and choose the duration range (if given)
Optionally set number of guests or ship filter on results

templates.name: Add cruise to favorites from search
templates.description: Search cruises to {sail_to} (optionally from {sail_from}, {dates}, {guests} guests) and add a result to favorites.
steps: Select departure port and dates if given
Set number of guests if given
Click the favorite heart on a cruise result

templates.name: Search and book a cruise
templates.description: Search cruises to {sail_to} from {sail_from} and start/complete booking of a sailing.
steps: Select destination, departure port, dates, duration
Choose a sailing and click Start Booking
Continue through specials, room type, rate, room location and number
Continue to checkout and select payment option

templates.name: Open Plan menu help/FAQ page
templates.description: Use the Plan menu to open the help/FAQ page about {topic}.
steps: Click the link or section for the topic

templates.name: View and filter cruise offers
templates.description: Open the offers/deals page and filter by {filter}.
steps: Navigate to the offers page via menu
Apply duration filter or show deals

templates.name: Order beverage package for booked cruiser
templates.description: Order {package} beverage package as a gift for {first_name} {last_name} on booking {booking_number}.
steps: Choose gift for a booked cruiser
Enter first name, last name, booking number

templates.name: Find travel agent by location
steps: Search the site for travel agent
Open Find A Travel Agent page
